title: Rhuberry by Chubby Juice E-Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
Rhuberry Shortfill E-Liquid:
Rhuberry delivers a perfectly balanced blend of tangy rhubarb and sweet, ripe raspberries, finished with a refreshing icy twist. The tartness of rhubarb is beautifully offset by the natural sweetness of raspberry, creating a delightful fusion of fruity flavours. A cooling hint of menthol adds a crisp finish, making this flavour an invigorating choice for those who enjoy a bold and refreshing fruit combination. Rhuberry is the perfect harmony of sweet, tart, and icy notes in every puff.
Product Features:
Brand:
Chubby Juice
Brand Origin:
UK
Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid.
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavoured E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free.
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine Shorts have been added – Tap here for our nic shot calculator
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
